timing: Mapping found in supplementary PDF while outcome-blind count scan was running. No SEMA4D/PLXNB2 values or contrasts inspected. Separate exploratory addendum; original 36-slot cluster plan unchanged.
mapping_source: 2026 published reanalysis DOI 10.3390/ijms27177920, Supplementary Tables S19 (HSC clusters 3+11) and S20 (Myeloid cluster 5). These are reanalysis assignments, not verified original-author per-cell labels.
statistics: Same donor statistics as analysis-spec-v1.json, separate BH family of two exploratory tests; recompute CPM after merging raw cluster counts.
marker_coherence: Descriptively compare myeloid CD163 and HSC NGFR pooled CPM across the two mapped compartments; agreement supports label coherence, not purity or independent annotation validation.
joint_direction_rule: Both mean differences positive and all leave-one-from-each-group differences positive; separate from q<0.05 and not a biological validation threshold.
limitations: Broad myeloid SEMA4D is not a pure macrophage replication.
No causal ligand-receptor test or drug-effect inference.
amendment: Source-label correction only, before compartment outcomes. NASH source group is described as MASH in the article.
